claims: The last NASA space shuttle mission was STS-135.
STS-135 featured the Space Shuttle Atlantis.
STS-135 launched from Kennedy Space Center.
STS-135 launched to the International Space Station.
STS-135 marked the final flight of the 30-year Space Shuttle program.
The Space Shuttle program concluded on July 21, 2011.
STS-135 launched from Launch Pad 39A, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
Chris Ferguson was the Commander of STS-135.
Doug Hurley was the Pilot of STS-135.
Rex Walheim was a Mission Specialist on STS-135.
Sandra Magnus was a Mission Specialist on STS-135.
The objective of STS-135 was delivering supplies and spare parts to the International Space Station using the Raffaello multipurpose logistics module.
STS-135 was the final flight of the NASA Space Shuttle orbiter fleet
